title: Cascade Ortho Rider Certificate — Coinsurance Follows the Practice Rendering the Remaining Treatment
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: network of the new practice and the first carried payment.**

For the first carried payment, the unpaid case benefit follows the network of the practice now treating the patient, as fixed on the latest transfer entry. This is because the coinsurance for the remaining treatment follows the practice that renders it.

On a rider whose in-network and out-of-network coinsurance differ:

- **Out of network to in network.** When the latest establishment entry is out of network and the latest transfer entry is in network, the unpaid case benefit is multiplied by the rider's in-network coinsurance divided by its out-of-network coinsurance.
- **In network to out of network.** When the latest establishment entry is in network and the latest transfer entry is out of network, the unpaid case benefit is multiplied by the out-of-network coinsurance divided by the in-network coinsurance.
- **Otherwise**, the unpaid case benefit is not changed by this rule.

The fee recognised for the case is not recomputed.

## Coinsurance by rider

| Rider | In network | Out of network | Do the two differ? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | 50 | 40 | yes |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | 50 | 50 | no |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | 50 | 50 | no |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | 50 | 40 | yes |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | 50 | 50 | no |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | 60 | 50 | yes |

## Combinations

| Rates differ | Latest establishment entry | Latest transfer entry | Multiplier on the unpaid case benefit |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | out of network | in network | in-network rate divided by out-of-network rate |
| yes | in network | out of network | out-of-network rate divided by in-network rate |
| yes | same network as the transfer entry | same network | none |
| no | any | any | none |

*Hypothetical figures:* on a rider paying 50 in network and 40 out of network, an unpaid case benefit of 812.00 becomes 1,015.00 when the case moves from an out-of-network practice to an in-network one (50 divided by 40). It becomes 649.60 when the case moves the other way (40 divided by 50).
